rationale: The assistant first suggested the pump filter check, which was premature. After the customer said it drained and held one bath mat, it correctly identified out-of-balance protection as normal behaviour and advised washing the mat with towels. It pushed an empty-drum spin test that wasn't needed, since full loads spin fine, and it didn't clearly say there is no fault, though it didn't suggest a part or escalation. Its closing advice was good and the customer was well served overall.
